candidates.change_summary: Replace assignment to balances[owner] setting it to totalDistributed with setting it to totalSupply (so owner ends up with full supply after NETM).
Replace assignment to balances[owner] with zeroing the owner's balance (owner gets no tokens after NETM).
Remove the assignment to owner (no longer sets owner to msg.sender) so balances change may apply to previous owner instead of caller.
Make onlyOwner modifier always succeed by removing the require check (allows any caller to invoke NETM, changing which address receives the balance update).
